primary_endpoint: Not stated; assessed one-year changes in gut microbiota in relation to changes in HSI and FIB-4.
efficacy_outcome: Gut microbiota changes were associated with changes in HSI and FIB-4. Reported differences included lower Akkermansia and higher Desulfovibrio in FIB-4 change T1, and lower Enterobacteriaceae with higher Sutterella, Faecalibacterium, and Blautia in T3; no quantitative treatment-effect comparison was reported.
